headline: Approved revised mission statement with edits, passing with all four members in favor.
summary: Members reviewed comments on a revised mission statement and agreed to edits, including tense corrections and changed wording about city solutions. Members adopted the statement, and John Hayes will send it to Mayor Pangallo. Members also noted a table at Volt & Vibe: An Eco-Rider Showcase on Sat. Sept. 19th from 1-4PM.
decisions: Approved the new mission statement with the listed edits, with all four members voting yes.

MEETING MINUTES
Introductions 
Present: John Hayes, Will Winn, Kevin Rice, Leigh Chanderl
Absent: Zach , Bill Burnham
Discuss revised mission statement/finalize prior to vote on Regular meeting 9/23/26
 Neal’s comments (from a previously recieved email):
o Grammatical corrections (tense)
o City solutions vs. “Programs, legislation, and other actions that promote the....” 
This will be changed
o Kevin’s suggestion (3rd bullet) has been incorporated
o Order? Agreed to leave as-is
o Supporting the state – does it belong in the mission statement? We may work at 
the state and federal level, especially if it affects Salem, we have a stake/voice but
we are not going to change everything statewide
 A motion to adopt the new mission statement with the above edits is made by Will Winn,
seconded by Kevin Rice, and passes with all in favor.
Will Winn Yes

John Hayes Yes
